title: Osmium and cadmium implants in the M-types

tellings.quote: These metal implants contain osmium and cadmium, which are extremely rare earth metals.

plain: Some of the small three-fingered bodies said to come from Nazca, Peru, the ones Michels calls the M-types, are said to carry metal implants made with osmium and cadmium. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, calling them "extremely rare earth metals." He raises it because unusual metals inside the bodies would point away from a simple fake.
